title: Router placement refusals are silent — the flagship 'tiers you hold' refusal never teaches
detail: Ruling 4: 'You can only place tiers you hold — flagged as the single biggest behavioral change'; the tutorial doctrine is 'learned by consequence, never silently' (this PR's own test comment). Arm_Placement arms any tier, the ghost previews valid (topology-only check), and .Box_Piece_Exhausted is swallowed — the flagship 'no' is unreadable.
recommended_fix: Mirror commit_draw's else on the Place_Release path: on material refusal set inp.last_reject/inp.reject_tick (the existing toast channel), matching the QoS-refusal doctrine.

title: Ruling 7's era 1-2 authored-brush tutorial arc is unreachable in the shipped app (APP_ERA=3, forward-only advance)
detail: Briefing L4: 'Era 1-2 sleep + authored brushes... the first "no" lands on a greedy-but-SAFE player under zero pressure'. The app hard-starts at era 3 and era advance is forward-only, so no player path reaches eras 1-2 — the AC is implemented and sim-proven (econ-check) but cannot manifest. Disclosed (PR disclosure 1) yet unresolved.
recommended_fix: Surface the already-filed flag for the user ruling; on adoption, drop APP_ERA to 1 (or add an era-1 start path) so the tutorial arc is playable.

title: Briefing's LOOK gate ('palcheck calm-board gates re-run green') undemonstrable at HEAD — T2/palcheck red incl. a pre-existing control demo
evidence: harness at ad8afca, this machine: 'FAIL box_spine — T2 116000ms: 921600/921600 pixels differ (bbox [0, 0, 1279, 719])'; control demo untouched by this PR: 'FAIL advance_fire — T2 15000ms: 921600/921600 pixels differ'; 'PASS boot ticks=100'; 'palcheck: 61 check(s) FAILED'; T1 green: '2520 ticks verified against the manifest — bit-for-bit (ODN-11)'. pr-body.md: 'palcheck | **pre-existing local red** — see disclosure'. Briefing gate: 'Look/palcheck calm-board gates re-run green.'
detail: The 100%-pixel T2 failures reproduce identically on a pre-existing demo (advance_fire), confirming disclosure 2's not-caused-here attribution — but the briefing's LOOK gate requirement is green-or-nothing, and the PR's '50/50 demos green' row is not reproducible in the reviewing environment. The golden source-of-truth decision the PR routes gates merge reliance on T2/palcheck.
recommended_fix: User rules on the golden source of truth (local re-bless vs CI render) per disclosure 2; then re-bless and re-run T2 + palcheck before the LOOK gate is cited as green.

title: PR overstates era-3 calibration as a 'two-sided' bind; its own row shows only the piece wall spoke
evidence: pr-body.md: 'era3-slope: the bind is two-sided — the bot exhausts its 10-basic kit (piece-starved = true) exactly as the record frames Era 3'. Its own row, reproduced exactly by 'odin run harness -- econ-check' at this sha: 'era3-slope    24000     20      10         0         0         0    10  [2327,2400]       216          92           0  true' (refusals=0, episodes=0, min_stock=216 of 240).
detail: The record's Era-3 mechanism is 'demand growth outruns restore growth' (a slope); the evidence shows a piece-kit wall only — the spool never came within one draw of empty (216/240). 'Two-sided' overstates the calibration result the PR otherwise reports honestly.
recommended_fix: Reword to the one-sided piece wall, or add a spool-binding era-3 scenario so both halves are evidenced before the fun-test-gate retune.
